items.source: This interface extends Phased, and the getPhase() method's return value indicates the phase within which this Lifecycle component should be started and stopped. The startup process begins with the lowest phase value and ends with the highest phase value (Integer.MIN_VALUE is the lowest possible, and Integer.MAX_VALUE is the highest possible). The shutdown process will apply the reverse order. Any components with the same value will be arbitrarily ordered within the same phase.
items.translation: 该接口扩展了Phased，且getPhase()方法的返回值指示此Lifecycle组件应在哪个阶段启动和停止。启动过程从最低的阶段值开始，到最高的阶段值结束（Integer.MIN_VALUE是最低可能值，Integer.MAX_VALUE是最高可能值）。关闭过程将按相反顺序应用。任何具有相同值的组件将在同一阶段内任意排序。

items.source: Any Lifecycle components within the context that do not also implement SmartLifecycle will be treated as if they have a phase value of 0. This allows a SmartLifecycle component to start before those Lifecycle components if the SmartLifecycle component has a negative phase value, or the SmartLifecycle component may start after those Lifecycle components if the SmartLifecycle component has a positive phase value.
items.translation: 上下文中的任何未同时实现SmartLifecycle的Lifecycle组件，将被视为具有0的阶段值。这使得如果SmartLifecycle组件具有负阶段值，它可以在这些Lifecycle组件之前启动；或者如果SmartLifecycle组件具有正阶段值，它可以在这些Lifecycle组件之后启动。

items.source: A value of false indicates that the component prefers to be skipped in a pause scenario, neither receiving a Lifecycle.stop() call nor a subsequent Lifecycle.start() call, analogous to a plain Lifecycle implementation. It will only receive a Lifecycle.stop() call on close and on explicit context-wide stopping but not on pause.
items.translation: 值为 `false` 表示该组件在暂停场景中倾向于被跳过，既不接收 `Lifecycle.stop()` 调用，也不接收随后的 `Lifecycle.start()` 调用，类似于普通的 `Lifecycle` 实现。它仅在关闭和显式的全局停止时接收 `Lifecycle.stop()` 调用，而在暂停时不会接收该调用。

items.source: The isAutoStartup() return value indicates whether this object should be started at the time of a context refresh. The callback-accepting stop(Runnable) method is useful for objects that have an asynchronous shutdown process. Any implementation of this interface must invoke the callback's run() method upon shutdown completion to avoid unnecessary delays in the overall ApplicationContext shutdown.
items.translation: `isAutoStartup()` 的返回值指示此对象是否应在上下文刷新时启动。接受回调的 `stop(Runnable)` 方法适用于具有异步关闭过程的对象。该接口的任何实现必须在关闭完成后调用回调的`run()` 方法，以避免整体`ApplicationContext` 关闭过程中出现不必要的延迟。

items.source: The LifecycleProcessor will call only this variant of the stop method; i.e. Lifecycle.stop() will not be called for SmartLifecycle implementations unless explicitly delegated to within the implementation of this method.
items.translation: `LifecycleProcessor` 将仅调用此版本的 `stop` 方法；即，除非在此方法的实现中显式委托，否则不会为 `SmartLifecycle` 实现调用 `Lifecycle.stop()`。

items.source: A value of false indicates that the component is intended to be started through an explicit Lifecycle.start() call instead, analogous to a plain Lifecycle implementation.
items.translation: 值为 `false` 表示该组件旨在通过显式的 Lifecycle.start() 调用来启动，类似于普通的 Lifecycle 实现。

items.source: This is different from the common phase 0 associated with regular Lifecycle implementations, putting the typically auto-started SmartLifecycle beans into a later startup phase and an earlier shutdown phase.
items.translation: 这与常规 Lifecycle 实现关联的常见阶段 0 不同，它将通常自动启动的 SmartLifecycle Bean 置于稍后的启动阶段和较早的关闭阶段。

items.source: The provided callback is used by the LifecycleProcessor to support an ordered, and potentially concurrent, shutdown of all components having a common shutdown order value. The callback must be executed after the SmartLifecycle component does indeed stop.
items.translation: 提供的回调由 `LifecycleProcessor` 使用，以支持具有公共关闭顺序值的所有组件的有序且可能并发的关闭。该回调必须在`SmartLifecycle` 组件确实停止后执行。

items.source: The default implementation returns DEFAULT_PHASE in order to let stop() callbacks execute before regular Lifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 默认实现返回DEFAULT_PHASE，以便让stop()回调在常规的Lifecycle实现之前执行。

items.source: Note that, due to the auto-startup support in SmartLifecycle, a SmartLifecycle bean instance will usually get initialized on startup of the application context in any case. As a consequence, the bean definition lazy-init flag has very limited actual effect on SmartLifecycle beans.
items.translation: 请注意，由于 `SmartLifecycle` 中的自动启动支持，`SmartLifecycle` Bean 实例通常会在应用程序上下文启动时初始化。因此，Bean 定义的懒加载标志对 `SmartLifecycle` Bean 的实际影响非常有限。

items.source: Note that certain SmartLifecycle components come with a different default phase: for example, executors/schedulers with Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2.
items.translation: 注意，某些 `SmartLifecycle` 组件具有不同的默认阶段：例如，带有 `Integer.MAX_VALUE / 2` 的调度器/执行器。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to Lifecycle.stop() and immediately triggers the given callback in the calling thread. Note that there is no synchronization between the two, so custom implementations may at least want to put the same steps within their common lifecycle monitor (if any).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 Lifecycle.stop()，并立即在调用线程中触发给定的回调。请注意，这两者之间没有同步机制，因此自定义实现至少应该将其中的相同步骤放在其公共生命周期监视器（如果有）内。

items.source: The default implementation returns true.
items.translation: 默认实现返回true。

items.source:
Example: if component B depends on component A having already started,
then component A should have a lower phase value than component B. During
the shutdown process, component B would be stopped before component A.
items.translation: 如果组件 B 依赖于组件 A 已经启动，则组件 A 的相位值应低于组件 B。在关闭过程中，组件 B 将在组件 A 之前停止。

items.source:
Any explicit "depends-on" relationship will take precedence over the phase
order such that the dependent bean always starts after its dependency and
always stops before its dependency.
items.translation: 任何显式的“依赖”关系都将优先于阶段顺序，以确保依赖的 Bean 总是在其依赖项之后启动，并在其依赖项之前停止。

items.source: Returns true if this Lifecycle component is able to participate in a restart sequence, receiving corresponding Lifecycle.stop() and Lifecycle.start() calls with a potential pause in-between.
items.translation: 如果此 `Lifecycle` 组件能够参与重启序列，则返回 `true，即在中间可能暂停的情况下接收相应的 Lifecycle.stop() 和 Lifecycle.start() 调用。

items.source: Returns true if this Lifecycle component should get started automatically by the container at the time that the containing ApplicationContext gets refreshed or restarted.
items.translation: 如果此 `Lifecycle` 组件应在包含的 ApplicationContext 刷新或重启时自动启动，则返回 `true`。

items.translation: SmartLifecycle 的默认阶段：Integer.MAX_VALUE。

items.source: Return the phase that this lifecycle object is supposed to run in.
items.translation: 返回该生命周期对象应该运行的阶段。

items.source: Indicates that a Lifecycle component must stop if it is currently running.
items.translation: 指示生命周期组件如果当前正在运行，则必须停止。
